statement: The whole numbers 1, 2, 3, ... are written in rows. Row 1 holds 1 number, row 2 holds the next 2 numbers, row 3 holds the next 3 numbers, and so on. What is the first number in row 20?

choices.misconception: I added up the lengths of rows 1 to 19 but forgot to add 1, so I gave the last number of row 19.
I added up the lengths of rows 1 to 20, which gives the last number of row 20.
I added up the lengths of rows 1 to 20 and then added 1, which is the start of row 21.
I added the row lengths 1 to 19 as 19 x 20 without halving, and then added 1.

hints: What is the last number in each row?
The last number in a row equals how many numbers have been written so far. Use the formula for the sum of the first few whole numbers, then step to the next number.

solutions.reliable: The last number in row n is 1 + 2 + ... + n, because that is how many numbers have been written. Rows 1 to 19 hold 19 x 20 / 2 = 190 numbers, so row 19 ends with 190 and row 20 starts with 191. Check on a small case: row 3 should start just after 1 + 2 = 3, at 4, which matches 1 / 2 3 / 4 5 6. The transferable idea: in a triangular table, the ends of the rows are the triangular numbers.

whyOnTest: Triangular arrangements are common, and every wrong choice is an off-by-one between the end of one row and the start of the next.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
